findings.title: Missing await
findings.body: The `await` before `fetchEstimatedMultiLayerL1Fee` was removed, so `result` is now a Promise instead of the L1 fee value. Any later use of `result` (hex conversion, adding to the gas fee, setting state) works on a Promise object. This breaks the multi-layer L1 fee shown on L2 networks such as Optimism. A rejected fetch is also no longer caught by the surrounding `try`. The same change was made in `app/components/Views/confirmations/components/TransactionReview/index.js`.

findings.title: Nonce not saved
findings.body: The Save button now calls `saveAndClose()` without passing the user-edited `nonce`. If `saveAndClose` forwards its argument to `save`, which the previous call suggests, `save` receives `undefined`. The user's custom nonce is then dropped, or an invalid nonce is set on the transaction.

findings.title: Unawaited callbacks
findings.body:
`onReject()` and `onConfirm()` are no longer awaited. Two things follow:
- The WalletConnect notification and `SIGNATURE_APPROVED`/`SIGNATURE_REJECTED` analytics events fire before signing or rejection completes, even if it later fails.
- Any rejection becomes an unhandled promise rejection instead of propagating to the caller.

The Save button now calls `saveAndClose()` without passing the user-edited `nonce`. If `saveAndClose` forwards its argument to `save`, which the previous call suggests, `save` receives `undefined`. The user's custom nonce is then dropped, or an invalid nonce is set on the transaction.

- The WalletConnect notification and `SIGNATURE_APPROVED`/`SIGNATURE_REJECTED` analytics events fire before signing or rejection completes, even if it later fails.
- Any rejection becomes an unhandled promise rejection instead of propagating to the caller.
